title: Retry deployment with new canister ID: update frontend canister targeting and preserve custom domain setup

requirements.summary: Update frontend-facing deployment documentation to reflect deploying to a newly provisioned canister ID and serving the live site from it.
acceptanceCriteria: A new canister ID is created/selected for deployment (different from the previously used one).
The deployment completes successfully without the prior internal build/deploy error.
The app is reachable at the new canister’s icp0.io URL.

file_operations.description: Document the redeployment expectation that a NEW canister ID is used, and call out where the frontend reads the backend canister ID so it can be updated in lockstep after redeploy. Keep guidance capability-focused (no backend implementation details).

requirements.summary: Update the frontend actor configuration so createActorWithConfig targets the newly deployed backend canister ID without touching immutable hooks.
acceptanceCriteria: After deployment, the frontend loads without canister-resolution errors and can create the backend actor successfully.
Any generated canister-ID references used by the frontend are consistent with the newly deployed canister.
No changes are made to the immutable hook files (e.g., `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`).

file_operations.description: Update the configuration used by createActorWithConfig to resolve the backend canister ID for the newly deployed canister (e.g., via the project’s generated canister ID source and/or build-time environment configuration) so actor creation succeeds after redeploy. Use the selected core-infrastructure component’s backend connection configuration capabilities where applicable. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Ensure custom domain verification and documentation remain correct and unchanged in behavior after switching to a new canister deployment.
acceptanceCriteria: No regressions are introduced in custom domain configuration documentation (`frontend/CUSTOM_DOMAIN_DEPLOYMENT.md`).

file_operations.description: Verify the file remains a single-line domain verification file containing exactly `sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.in` (no additional domains; no formatting changes that would affect verification).

Review and, if necessary, adjust wording to ensure instructions remain consistent when deploying to a new canister ID (while preserving the existing custom-domain setup and avoiding breaking changes to the documented flow).
